items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I had gone up to Tesh... I said to Tesh -- we'll drive you home... Tesh had his hands in his overcoat pocket... he died during that night.

ctx.x: Nothing to do with Texas Guyon-- and it was a ballroom out near the old Marlboro Theater--- out in that direction - on the west side and we were very happy about that. And, so, that's when we were all set to go in there and I had gone up to Tesh and I had gone up to see in the early evening - to see Jack Church; the guitar player---
